mapper.select: SELECT st.store_nm, COUNT(*) as total_records, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '정상' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '지각' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '조기퇴근' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as early_leave_count, ROUND(AVG( TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(s.working_time, 1, 2)) + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(s.working_time, 4, 2)) / 60 ), 1) as avg_working_hours FROM schedule s JOIN tb_user u ON s.user_no = u.user_no JOIN store_employee se ON u.user_no = se.user_no JOIN store st ON se.store_no = st.store_no WHERE st.store_no = #{storeNo} AND TO_CHAR(s.schdul_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{searchDate}
